composite.name: QBench Composite Index
composite.basis: Nine evaluation components, four categories, and component weights published for Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5. QBench calculates an independent percentile-based score and does not reproduce AA's native score.
composite.normalization: Highest reported score per exact model name is converted to a 0–100 midrank percentile among models with a numeric result; ties receive average ranks.
composite.configurationPolicy: Best reported configuration per model and evaluation. Not a controlled same-effort or same-harness comparison.
composite.method: An evaluation contributes only if it has at least eight unique model names. Available component percentiles are weighted by official relative weights and renormalized within each category; the four categories receive equal 25% weight. A model is ranked only with all four categories and at least 50% official total weight. Missing scores are never imputed and model aliases are not inferred.
caveats: Percentiles depend on the imported model cohort and may change with coverage.
Best reported configurations can differ by evaluation.
Some public leaderboard runs do not share AA's internal harness; matching benchmark versions do not guarantee identical conditions.
Below-threshold rows remain in standalone results but do not contribute to the composite.
AA native scores and QBench percentiles are separate measures.
The separately imported Benchmark Atlas AA-Omniscience accuracy-only table is not the full accuracy-plus-hallucination-rate component and is excluded from the composite.

extendedIndex.methodology: QBench Composite Index 3.5: best published configuration per exact model within each eligible benchmark is converted to a midrank percentile. Each benchmark contributes equally inside its single primary domain; six domain means are then averaged equally. A model is ranked only with results in at least four eligible evaluations spanning at least three of six domains. Every contributing evaluation must have at least eight unique model names. Missing scores are not imputed. This broad percentile index is independent of AA's native index and does not claim identical harnesses.
